title: Decomposition Profiles and Weisfeiler-Leman Dimension for Graphs of Bounded Rank Width
summary: The Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) algorithm tests graph isomorphism by assigning colours to $d$-tuples of vertices and iteratively refining the colouring according to neighbourhood configurations until it stabilizes. Increasing $d$ allows the test to detect finer structural differences between graphs, but the computational cost grows exponentially with $d$. The central question is which dimension allows us to distinguish nonisomorphic graphs.
